name: Granite 3.3 8B Instruct
notes: Architecture: GraniteForCausalLM, hidden 4096, 40 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, rope_theta 10000000, 131072 native context, vocab 49159 with tie_word_embeddings true. The serving-relevant shape is 40 layers at hidden 4096 - same width as Llama-3.1-8B but 25% deeper, and only 32 query heads instead of Llama's 32 at the same width, so this is a deeper-narrower-attention design with a large MLP (intermediate_size 12800) relative to the attention block. More layers at the same KV-head count means more KV per token than the 8B models it competes with, at identical context length. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128; gqa_ratio = 4.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 40 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 163840 B/token = 160.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 20.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
